intro: The Goddess Provides is an introductory kaldorei quest centered on recognizing Elune's divine gifts. Set in the boughs of Teldrassil following the end of the Long Vigil, it teaches young night elves to embrace the lunar guidance and cloaking shadows bestowed by Mother Moon.

clips.title: Quest text
paras: You are born kaldorei--the children of the stars--and have inherited a birthright unlike any other in this world. Elune's grace may illuminate our strengths, helping our strikes hit true, or it may help conceal us just as the moon may eclipse the sun.
Our Long Vigil after the defense of Mount Hyjal has ended, and we have joined an Alliance of others--which you will meet in due time. For now, you are nestled in the boughs of Teldrassil.
Demonstrate Mother Moon's gifts, and bask in her blessings.

clips.title: Completion
paras: You have seen what our goddess provides. Use it well, and she will never forsake you.
